limitations: Internal coverage judgement, not external accreditation.
Written answers self-assessed against explicit model/criteria.
All evaluation rates and hormone graph values illustrative, not current clinical statistics.
Narrow current terminology qualifications avoid presenting cached contraception simplifications as universal mechanisms.
